data.description:
## Goal
Write tests/scripts/test-check-verifier-verdict.sh before check-verifier-verdict.sh exists (RED phase). All test cases must fail on invocation until T2 is complete.

## Files to Create
- tests/scripts/test-check-verifier-verdict.sh

## Test Cases (6)
1. JSON with P1=PASS → check-verifier-verdict.sh exits 0
2. JSON with P1=FAIL → check-verifier-verdict.sh exits 1
3. JSON with P1=BLOCKED → check-verifier-verdict.sh exits 1
4. JSON with P1=INCONCLUSIVE → check-verifier-verdict.sh exits 1
5. JSON missing P1 field → check-verifier-verdict.sh exits 2
6. Malformed JSON → check-verifier-verdict.sh exits 2

## Acceptance Criteria
- bash tests/scripts/test-check-verifier-verdict.sh exits non-zero (RED — script under test does not yet exist)
- chmod +x tests/scripts/test-check-verifier-verdict.sh

## Testing Mode
RED
data.title: T1: RED — Write test suite for check-verifier-verdict.sh
